entries.headline: Merged page interaction tools into browser-click
entries.summary: Merged pull request #25, adding Marks and Page Actions that let the Assistant inspect, annotate, scroll, click, and type on the current page with approval and refusal rules documented in the extension.

entries.headline: Added Claude Code as a browser-click backend
entries.summary: Merged pull request #15, adding a native messaging host and conversation handling so browser-click can answer through the user’s local Claude Code installation, with saved sessions and an options-page setup flow.

entries.headline: Improved live literature-search execution
entries.summary: Updated the researcher to run queries in parallel, cache Europe PMC full text with bounds, reuse transient Crossref retraction checks briefly, and batch DOI notice lookups.
